violations.message: U1 pin 4 is labelled pin4, but KiCad symbol library Regulator_Linear Regulator_Linear:AMS1117-3.3 has no pin 4
violations.why: A pin number the package doesn't have can't be placed on the footprint, so its trace goes nowhere.
violations.fix_hint: Remove pin4 from U1's pinLabels and route that net to the pin the pin map names for it.
